Your story starts with one instruction

DISCOVER · Variables · strings

Remember a detail with a variable

A variable is a name that refers to a value. Write hero = "Nova" to store a name. Later, use hero without quotes to read the value.

The equals sign assigns a value; it does not print anything. print("hero") displays the word hero. print(hero) displays the value stored under that name. Define a variable before you use it.
